saw_lines: Sugar free snack buyers check the label and the taste first, then rebuy the one that fits how they already snack.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the buyer decides whether the snack fits their day.
Your same copy runs in 8 of 21 ads, so keep the body text and swap the opening line and the image in each of those 8 ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: One exact copy runs in 8 of 21 ads, so buyers see the same words and tune out. Keep the body text, swap the opening line and image in those 8 ads, and give each new opener one reason to buy.
None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has no reason to trust the claim before clicking. Collect one real figure, like your review count, and lead three new ads with it.
8 of 21 copy ads open on the same 2010 line, so most new buyers see one story and scroll. Test two new openers against it: the blood sugar curve from your site, and the Crispy Cream White.
0 of 21 copy ads carry an offer, and none of your 30 live ads answers a price or shipping question. A new buyer has no reason to act today. Open three new ads with a first order offer.
